messages:
Alex Rivera: hey all, curious if anyone ran into this: used Migration Assistant to pull my stuff from a personal MBP and now Kandji shows "MDM profile invalid signature" and System Settings warns the profile can't be verified. device is otherwise online. stuck on Okta device trust failing.
Nina Flores: welcome @Alex! migration can rewrite some low-level certificates and occasionally the profile identifier/signature mismatch happens. did you migrate the whole system or only user data?
Alex Rivera: did a full macOS transfer over Thunderbolt—chose "transfer everything". seemed faster.
IT Onboard Bot: Auto-scan: serial C02MIGRATE01 enrolled, profile_status: invalid_signature. Suggested actions: 1) attempt local enrollment refresh: `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment`; 2) re-install agent via Kandji remote job; 3) if still failing, re-image. Ticket #ONB-10121 created.
Sam Patel: hey Alex - quick path: try the renew command first (no reboot). If that returns "profile fetched" then re-check Okta. If it says no enrollment, we can push an agent reinstall which preserves user data.
Alex Rivera: ran `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment`. Terminal returns: "No enrollment found for this device."
Nina Flores: that suggests the local record got clobbered during migration. I'm going to push a Kandji agent reinstall and a fresh MDM profile. Sam, can you approve?
Sam Patel: approved. triggering remote reinstall (agent reinstall + profile). Please don't power cycle for 10 mins.
IT Onboard Bot: Kandji job "reinstall-agent-and-profile" queued for C02MIGRATE01 by Sam Patel. Estimated 3-5 min.
IT Onboard Bot: Kandji job completed: agent reinstalled, MDM profile installed. Device status -> online.
Alex Rivera: just checked Settings: MDM profile shows up and Okta trust passed. looks good. thanks!
Nina Flores: nice. quick onboarding note: avoid full system migration before MDM enrollment if possible; migration of system-level certs can cause signature mismatches. we usually recommend user-data-only transfer or joining the device to Kandji first. can you add a short line to the onboarding doc?
Alex Rivera: will add one-liner. also saving this thread for myself in case I forget what happened. thanks y'all :pray:
